answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 31 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is logged against the wander challenge, the nadir audit can replay the fable history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3348 identities would post 2583 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
